en.title: MOSS-Image: open-weight text-to-image with layout control
en.summary: MOSS-Image is a 5B open-weight image model with text and layout controls. Local inference requires compatible compute; no unified hosted API or price has been verified.
en.detail: MOSS-Image is an OpenMOSS text-to-image model family with Base and SFT variants. Its official repository and model card describe text rendering, JSON layout control, fine-tuning and a ComfyUI integration. The model weights and bundled inference code are Apache-2.0, but this is not a hosted image-generation subscription: the documented local path requires an NVIDIA GPU with CUDA and incurs the operator's compute and infrastructure costs. We did not verify a unified hosted API, API price, account access, or independent output-quality benchmark. Compare it with FLUX, Stable Diffusion and Ideogram on text placement, layout adherence, hardware and setup burden, and whether you need a hosted service or local control. Treat quality statements as official claims until tested on the same prompts.
bestFor: Creators and developers able to run image models on compatible local or managed GPU infrastructure
Workflows that need prompt-driven text placement or structured layout inputs
notIdealFor: People expecting a ready-to-use free online image generator
Teams without CUDA-compatible compute that need predictable hosted API pricing
limitations: 5B model weights and inference code are Apache-2.0; license does not provide free hosted compute
Official quick start specifies Python and NVIDIA CUDA GPU requirements; actual memory and speed depend on resolution and hardware
No unified hosted inference API or price was verified
Text rendering and layout benefits are official claims, not an independent benchmark
compareAxes: Text rendering and layout adherence versus FLUX, Stable Diffusion and Ideogram

en.pricingSummary: Weights and inference code are publicly available under Apache-2.0. Users still pay or provide compute; no unified hosted API price was verified.
